ideas.idea: Add an absolute canonical link on / and /guides
ideas.why: No canonical is set anywhere in the files, and adding one on a real domain helps consolidate signals.

ideas.idea: Replace the placeholder trailhead.example domain with the real origin in sitemap, canonicals and Sitemap line
ideas.why: The sitemap uses a placeholder domain, so the real origin must be chosen for absolute URLs.

ideas.idea: List actual routes as text on the guides page, each on its own page/URL
ideas.why: guides.vue claims graded routes but lists none, so adding crawlable route content gives readers and machines something to find.

ideas.idea: Expand the home page with a text description of the walks and links to individual guides
ideas.why: index.vue has only an h1 and a button, so descriptive text and links add content and crawl paths.

ideas.idea: Delete the noindex middleware or drop /guides from the sitemap (remove the header)
ideas.why: This restates the known noindex-on-/guides problem.

ideas.idea: Blocking /admin in robots.txt hides its noindex (conditional, fine if only private)
ideas.why: The report itself says this is fine for a private page, so it is a harmless note about a deliberate choice.

ideas.idea: Use useHead or useSeoMeta for a distinct title and description on /guides and new pages
ideas.why: This repeats the known problem of one shared title and description.
